body:
Tested locally, it works as expected both with subwindow embedding enabled and disabled.

However, when subwindow embedding is disabled, the stretched popup will be blurry when using the `viewport` stretch mode (instead of being pixelated as I'd expect). I recall seeing another issue (and PR) specifically tackling this.

### Subwindow embedding enabled

`disabled` | `canvas_items` | `viewport`
-|-|-
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b4fbbbae-2b22-4e3e-bd99-4e45522b1d3c) | ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2ba0a9a6-a42a-4100-af4e-59e2c16955fe) | ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9b6eed34-35ae-4c3c-8ee7-505f74afd609)

### Subwindow embedding disabled

`disabled` | `canvas_items` | `viewport`
-|-|-
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a9467768-0ab2-4375-b921-1470365c6a80) | ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/57995e97-92d1-4272-bd6c-92917a7780b7) | ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/008a1932-5abb-46a8-935f-36d325776474)

Also, this PR doesn't fix https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/98672:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3bf34da3-ab3f-45b2-a24f-53819e45e0b6)
Seems to be working as expected with both embedded and native windows.
